# Domain Vault

> Domain Vault is a dark-mode dashboard for tracking domain renewals, costs, DNS records, and provider credentials. No API keys required.

## Main Pages
- [Home](https://getdomainvault.com): Product overview and features.
- [Pricing](https://getdomainvault.com/#pricing): Plans for Personal, Start-up, Business, and Agency.
- [Downloads](https://getdomainvault.com/downloads.html): Desktop apps for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
- [Lifetime Deal](https://getdomainvault.com/ltd-pricing): Current promotional offer.

## Key Features
- [Renewal Calendar](https://getdomainvault.com): Track expirations and export to .ics.
- [DNS Inspector](https://getdomainvault.com): Live DNS record queries.
- [Credential Vault](https://getdomainvault.com): Store registrar logins securely.

## Optional
- [FAQ](https://getdomainvault.com/#faq): Common questions about data, refunds, and sync.
